task: USP Match — Low-Poly / PS1 Mechanical Breakdown

parts.name: slide
parts.note: locked to the rear, serrations, ejection port, breech face

parts.name: barrel
parts.note: exposed stainless match barrel, chamber block, locking hood

parts.name: frame
parts.note: dust cover rail, beavertail, checkered grip, trigger guard, hammer

parts.name: compensator
parts.note: front barrel weight with vent slots

static_display.projection: near-orthographic (18 deg FOV long lens) + true orthographic camera available
ps1_effects: screen-space vertex snapping + wobble (custom vertex shader)
internal render downscale to chunky framebuffer
CRT scanlines, barrel warp, chromatic split, vignette

animation.loop: seamless, verified t=0 == t=1 with max error 0.00000
animation.continuity: C0-continuous, verified via step-halving (delta ratio 3.92, expected ~4)

sequence.motion: slides up into / drops out of the grip
retracts rearward over the exposed barrel then returns
lifts out once the slide clears

mechanical_linkage: recoil spring only appears once the slide is off the frame
hammer cocks as the slide travels rearward
rear takedown pin withdraws laterally before the upper can rotate (interlock)
upper receiver pivots open about the real FRONT pivot pin (~35 deg)
BCG retracts along the upper receiver rails
bolt head rotates 22.5 deg to unlock (real AR locking lugs)
optional_ar15.no_radial_explosion: verified: motion is staged and axis-constrained, not a radial blast

verification.method: headless smoke test executing the answer.html module body against real three@0.160.0
verification.temp_dir: tmptest/ (installed three@0.160.0 locally, deleted after the run)
highlights: scene builds without throwing (9 root children, 164 meshes)
front sight emissive green 0x39ff6a / rear sight emissive red 0xff2b34
no external 3D asset loaders or model files
USP transforms finite across the whole cycle
USP loop seamless (t=0 == t=1, max err 0.00000)
magazine motion predominantly vertical (dy=3.440 vs dx=0.040)
all USP parts have zero lateral Z drift (no radial explosion)
AR: pivot opens 0.620 rad, rear pin withdraws 0.950, BCG retracts -2.20, bolt unlocks -0.393 rad
AR interlock: pin fully out before the upper begins rotating
AR stage order: pin -> pivot -> BCG
AR loop seamless (t=0 == t=1, max err 0.00000)
